_comment: FOSSynd English UI strings (ADR-0016). Keys are stable identifiers; do not rename without an ADR. All values are original FOSSynd text (docs/LEGAL.md): no text from any commercial game.
app.title: FOSSYND
hud.controls: [SHIFT+CLICK] QUEUE   [CLICK ENEMY/RIGHT] ATTACK   [1-4] GROUP   [A]LL   [P] PERSUADE   [F] FREE   [H] MEDKIT   [S] SHIELD   [C] SCAN   [B] DRUGS   [/] BAR   ;/' ADJUST   [E] HIJACK   [R] RESTART   [F5] SAVE   [F9] LOAD
hud.winSub: PRESS R TO RUN IT AGAIN
title.controls.gadgets: H  MEDKIT   S  SHIELD   C  SCAN   B  DRUGS   [/] BAR   ;/' ADJUST
title.controls.misc: ARROWS  SCROLL   SPACE  PAUSE   R  RESTART   E  HIJACK   ESC  QUIT
title.footer: FOSSYND v{version}  -  FREE OPEN SOURCE SYNDICATE
mission.demo.name: Downtown Sweep
mission.demo.desc: Sweep the downtown block: eliminate every enemy agent while keeping civilian casualties down.
mission.escort.name: Rooftop Exfil
mission.escort.desc: Escort DELTA across the rooftops to the exfil tile; losing DELTA fails the run.
mission.blackout.name: Blackout
mission.blackout.desc: Breach the substation wall and destroy the relay before the grid comes back up.
mission.assembly.name: Assembly
mission.assembly.desc: Recruit the rally crowd with the Compliance Beacon and bring four of them under control.
mission.overpass.name: Overpass
mission.overpass.desc: Fight through the blockade and get a living agent to the far corner of the overpass.
mission.precinct.name: Precinct
mission.precinct.desc: Storm the precinct and eliminate the police patrols and the saboteur before he can rig the block.
mission.decapitation.name: Decapitation
mission.decapitation.desc: Cut the head off the operation: find and kill the OVERSEER while the garrison fights on.
mission.extraction.name: Extraction
mission.extraction.desc: Grab the briefcase on the far ledge and carry it back to the extraction tile.
mission.holdout.name: Holdout
mission.holdout.desc: Stand your ground in the Vostaran ruins and survive the raiders' assault until the clock runs out.
mission.caravan.name: Caravan
mission.caravan.desc: Escort the courier across the Sahari dunes and bring them alive to the far oasis gate.
mission.relay.name: Relay
mission.relay.desc: Breach the Anduran relay wall and destroy the transmitter before the garrison seals the pass.
mission.conclave.name: The Conclave
mission.conclave.desc: Storm the syndicate conclave and kill the OVERSEER; the praetorian guard and his bodyguards will fight to the last.
mission.cordon.name: Cordon
mission.cordon.desc: Break the cordon around the four depots and eliminate every sentry holding the ring.
mission.vault.name: Vault
mission.vault.desc: Crack the vault on the far shelf and carry the ledger back to the extraction tile through the guard line.
mission.uprising.name: Uprising
mission.uprising.desc: Turn the crowd with the Compliance Beacon and bring five of them over before the riot squad closes in.
